messages:
Alex: Quick check — who's on deck for the 14:00 UTC deploy today?
Plan: 14:00 canary (1%), 14:15 ramp to 10%, 14:30 full traffic. Need smoke owner, rollback owner, and prod-approve. Please reply with role and quick ✅/👀.

Jamie: I'm deploying the release. I'll kick off canary at 14:00 UTC and monitor metrics. ✅ Deploy owner.

Sasha: I'll do smoke at canary start, will run the checklist linked below and report pass/fail within 5m. QA owner. :white_check_mark:

Micah: I'll be rollback owner (kubectl and runbook). If latency > 250ms p50 or error rate > 0.8% I'll trigger rollback. 👀

Nina: Prod-approve from PM. Go for canary. ✅

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: 14:00 UTC. Canary window 15m. Notification channels: #eng-oncall, #infra, #support.

qa-bot: Smoke checklist: https://docs.internal/smoke/runbook
- [ ] healthchecks pass
- [ ] infer/runtime errors < 0.1%
- [ ] latencies normal

Alex: Rolling plan/quick runbook for rollback:
```
# quick rollback
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --to-revision=previous
# toggle traffic
curl -X POST https://router.internal/traffic -d '{"version":"previous"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
If anyone needs escalation, ping @micah and @alex.

Jamie: I'll post canary metrics link once it's up and mark status every 5m.

Sasha: I'll snapshot failing logs and paste short summary in thread if anything's weird. Also will mark final smoke: PASS/FAIL.

Nina: Adding legal compliance quick note — no changes to data handling in this release, fine from my side.

Alex: Great. Final signoffs: Jamie ✅, Sasha ✅ (tentative), Micah ✅, Nina ✅. If no objections by 13:55 UTC we go.

Jamie: Acknowledged. On deck and ready. :rocket:
